name: Susan McLain
occupation: State Representative (former classroom teacher and Metro councilor)

bio.statement: Her official page says she chairs the House Transportation Committee and co-chairs the I-5 Interstate Bridge Committee.
bio.excerpt: I am thrilled to serve as Chair of the House Transportation Committee and Co-Chair of the I-5 Interstate Bridge Committee.

bio.statement: Her official page says she represents House District 29 from West Hillsboro, Cornelius and Forest Grove.
bio.excerpt: I am honored to represent the people of House District 29 from West Hillsboro, Cornelius, and Forest Grove

bio.statement: The Capital Chronicle guide lists McLain as a classroom teacher for 42 years.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain says rent and homeownership costs are among the largest household expenses and prices are too high.
positions.excerpt: The cost of rent and homeownership is one of the biggest household expenses, and prices are simply too high.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain says she is willing to consider a wide range of tax reforms.
positions.excerpt: I'm willing to consider a wide range of tax reforms

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain says the Quality Education Model funding formula is outdated.
positions.excerpt: Our current funding model, the Quality Education Model (QEM), is outdated

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain says the gas tax is declining as a funding source and the state must transition to a sustainable tool.
positions.excerpt: Our primary funding source (the gas tax) is in decline, and we need to transition into a sustainable tool.

positions.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain says federal immigration agents have acted beyond their authority and without regard for due process or safety.
positions.excerpt: Agents have acted beyond the scope of their authority and without regard for due process or safety.

voting_record.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain says she sponsored policies to preserve Planned Parenthood funding and protect patient privacy.
voting_record.excerpt: I sponsored policies to preserve funding for Planned Parenthood and protect the privacy of patients.

voting_record.statement: In the Capital Chronicle questionnaire, McLain cites a 2026 expansion of the Earned Income Tax Credit as an accomplishment.
voting_record.excerpt: the largest expansion of the Earned Income Tax Credit in Oregon history

gaps: No public position found on public safety beyond immigration enforcement
Voting items are self-reported in the questionnaire; no roll calls collected (phase 1 scope)
collection_notes: Incumbent per House roster. Inventory consistent. Capital Chronicle HD 29 Democratic primary guide (primary opponent Mark Watson) is the main source; guide undated. Official page gave committee roles.
